name: NetScope IPv6 Auditor Controlled Laboratory
description: Reproducible benchmark suite for validating network measurement classification and edge cases against known ground truth.

testCases.name: Dual-Stack Fully Compliant Endpoint
testCases.ruleTested: Full dual-stack parity: A and AAAA records present, TCP and TLS handshakes succeed, HTTP 200 returned.
testCases.rationale: Serves as positive control for healthy dual-stack services.

testCases.name: HTTP 404 Not Found (Transport Control)
testCases.ruleTested: Section 6 Rule: 'HTTP 404 is not proof of transport failure.'
testCases.rationale: Application-layer 404 indicates TCP/TLS and routing succeeded; network path is healthy.

testCases.name: HTTP 500 Internal Server Error
testCases.ruleTested: Classification: Distinguish application 5xx from lower-level TCP/TLS transport drops.
testCases.rationale: Both stacks establish TCP, but application layer fails.

testCases.name: CORS Header Restriction (Browser-Only vs Network)
testCases.ruleTested: Section 6 Rule: 'CORS is not proof of IPv6 failure.'
testCases.rationale: CORS is a browser security policy enforced on origins, not an IP network transport failure.

testCases.name: Simulated IPv4-Only Sub-resource (Missing AAAA)
testCases.ruleTested: Section 6 Rule: 'A missing AAAA record blocks IPv6 resolution.'
testCases.rationale: Client cannot resolve IPv6 address when authoritative DNS only has A records.

testCases.name: Simulated IPv6 TCP Connection Reset / Black Hole
testCases.ruleTested: Section 6 Rule: 'An AAAA record alone does not prove IPv6 readiness.'
testCases.rationale: DNS resolves, but ingress firewall drops or rejects IPv6 TCP SYN packets.

testCases.name: Controlled Static Stylesheet Asset
testCases.rationale: Confirms CSS assets resolve and serve cleanly.

testCases.name: Controlled JavaScript Application Module
testCases.rationale: Confirms JavaScript assets resolve and serve cleanly.
